projects.title: Dual-Arm Robotic Automation of Metal Tube Surface Processing
projects.description:
• Using humanoid PR2 robot and ROS (Robot Operating System) framework, conceptualized and implemented automation solution for Metal Tube surface processing in simulation environment
• Developed and implemented Point Cloud processing algorithm of the point cloud captured by Microsoft Kinect sensor in C++ language using Point Cloud Library to generate 3D perception by approximating model of metal tubes of different geometry
• Developed and implemented algorithm to identify optimized locations on tube for dual-arm grasping that can provide greater manipulability and force resistance during machining.
• Implemented dual-arm synchronized manipulation to execute trajectories for surface processing * Validated system in Gazebo simulation environment (http://youtu.be/zXvfQSpo0w8)

projects.title: Multi-Agent Robotics Systems Using Visual Guidance
projects.description:
• Implemented algorithm for task distribution among multiple robots for final year capstone project
• Implemented Image Processing in MATLAB to determine position and orientation of individual robots in 2D Space
• Conceptualized and Designed robots by custom designing mechanical parts and single circuit board using Pro-E and EAGLE CadSoft for optimal performance and accuracy
• Programmed on board DSPIC33FJ series microcontroller in MPLAB IDE (C Language) for a system that includes motor controllers, communication, sensor input and actuation
• Co-ordinated Robots from central machine by transmitting commands using wireless module, CC2500 (Texas Instruments)
• Integrated motor controller with feedback on the same board and implemented PID subroutine for accuracy and fast response
